items.claim: Kevin Holland utilizes a tall, rangy stance with a backward lean that makes his chin difficult to reach.
items.quote: Kevin's kind of elusive. It kind of stands with his chin leaning back.

items.claim: Daniel Rodriguez found success against Kevin Holland by blitzing inside his reach and targeting the body to pull his hands down.
items.quote: uses the cross to the body to start pulling the hands down of Kevin Holland.
